items.title: Wynn Resorts (WYNN) Stock Looks Fairly Priced Despite Al Marjan Delays
items.summary: Wynn Resorts stock has fallen sharply over the past year, yet broader valuation checks suggest the shares may now lean cheap rather than clearly overvalued.
